rationale_summary: The document's dominant framing is innovation_enablement because its core justification for adopting voluntary, goal-based, risk-based, and agile soft-law guidelines is to avoid stifling AI innovation while mitigating risks that could cause social disagreement and inhibit AI adoption. Fundamental_rights is a close runner-up, anchoring Part 2's normative philosophies in human dignity, constitutional and international human rights, fairness, privacy, and democracy; however, innovation_enablement edges it out as the overarching rationale explaining why MIC and METI chose flexible business guidelines over binding rules to realize Society 5.0. Secondary rationales include consumer_public_safety (preventing harm to lives, bodies, minds, and property), economic_competitiveness (strengthening competitiveness and sustainable economic growth), social_stability (countering society-destabilizing disinformation and avoiding social divisions), and labor_transition (addressing labor shortages and promoting education and reskilling as human-AI task division shifts).

evidence_spans.quote: Thus, it was decided to draw up guidelines on the basis of the goal-based concept that would lead to the achievement of purposes through soft laws without any legally binding force that would encourage interested parties to make voluntary efforts to reduce societal risks in AI and promote innovations and use of AI.

When developing, providing, or using an AI system or service, each AI business actor should act in a way that does not violate the human rights guaranteed by the Constitution of Japan or granted internationally, as the foundation for accomplishing all matters to be conducted, including the matters described later.
evidence_spans.source_section: Part 2, C. Common Guiding Principles, 1) Human-Centric

evidence_spans.quote: Each AI business actor should avoid damage to the lives, bodies, minds, and properties of stakeholders during the development, provision, and use of AI systems and services. In addition, it is important that the environment is not damaged.
evidence_spans.source_section: Part 2, C. Common Guiding Principles, 2) Safety

evidence_spans.quote: Paying close attention to these possibilities enables to maximize the benefits from AI, strengthen competitiveness, and maintain and improve the business values.

Generative AI has enabled everyone to forge fake information that seems to be true and fair, so recognize the increasing risk of destabilizing and confusing the society through disinformation, misinformation, and biased information generated by AI, and take necessary countermeasures
evidence_spans.source_section: Part 2, C. Common Guiding Principles, 1) Human-Centric (3)

evidence_spans.quote: It is assumed that the division of tasks between AI and humans will change due to the expansion of generative AI use, so discuss actively about education and reskilling to promote new ways of working.
evidence_spans.source_section: Part 2, C. Common Guiding Principles, 8) Education/literacy (2)
